# Hand-labeled evaluation of test/coverage/impact signals

Allows precise scoring of compiled code intelligence signals (test coverage and impact detection) against a hand-labeled ground truth file in TOML format (kc-eval.toml). This supports micro-averaged precision/recall computation on coverage and change detection, ensuring improvements or regressions in extraction/normalization results can be measured objectively rather than visually. Reports per-label prediction detail and per-metric aggregates for further analysis.
